laws.rule: Acropolis tickets are sold for a chosen entry time slot on the Ministry of Culture's e-ticket platform (hhticket.gr); the ticket is valid from 15 minutes before to 15 minutes after the slot. The Ministry warns that 'skip the line' offers for Acropolis entry are misleading.
